title: Securing Singapore's satellite-dependent infrastructure and standards for satellite operators
asked: Dr Choo Pei Ling asked what measures secure Singapore's space-based critical information infrastructure, whether the Government has or plans cybersecurity and resilience standards for satellite operators, and what contingency plans exist for disruptions to satellite operators.
response: Mr Tan Kiat How said over 99% of Internet traffic goes via submarine cables internationally and terrestrial cables and radio networks domestically, so satellites are a secondary channel for some enterprises and the impact of disruptions today is limited. Aviation and maritime operational systems primarily use terrestrial connectivity, with satellite as a secondary mode. The Government will work with industry to enhance the security and resilience of Singapore's space infrastructure. Singapore participates in international standards bodies, and satellite operators adopt standards relevant to their use cases, with encryption for sensitive data.

key_points.point: Over 99% of Singapore's Internet traffic goes via submarine cables internationally and terrestrial cables and radio networks domestically.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: over 99% of our Internet traffic is transmitted internationally via submarine cables, and domestically via terrestrial cables and radio networks

key_points.point: Some enterprises use satellites as a secondary channel for communications or environmental monitoring.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: specific enterprises may use satellites as a secondary channel for communications or environmental monitoring

key_points.point: The impact of potential disruptions to satellite services today is limited.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: The impact of potential disruptions to satellite services today is therefore limited.

key_points.point: Aviation and maritime operational systems are primarily supported by terrestrial connectivity networks, with satellite as a secondary mode.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: operational systems in the aviation and maritime sectors are primarily supported by terrestrial connectivity networks, with satellite communications serving as a secondary mode of communications.

key_points.point: The Government will work with industry to enhance the security and resilience of Singapore's space infrastructure.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: the Government will work closely with the industry to enhance the security and resilience of Singapore’s space infrastructure.

key_points.point: Singapore participates in international bodies that set resilience and cybersecurity standards for the space industry.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: we participate actively in international bodies that set standards for resilience and cybersecurity for the space industry

key_points.point: Satellite operators and partners adopt cybersecurity and resilience standards relevant to their specific use cases.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: Satellite operators and their partners adopt cybersecurity and resilience standards relevant to their specific use cases

key_points.point: Users transmitting sensitive data adopt stringent encryption policies to protect data in transit.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: users that transmit sensitive data would also adopt stringent data encryption policies to protect the data in transit.

Whether the Government has established or plans to establish cybersecurity and resilience standards required of satellite operators
Measures in place to secure space-based critical information infrastructure dependent on satellite and space systems
supplementary: Domestic satellite cybersecurity monitoring, threat detection and attribution, resilience risks of hard-to-repair or legacy satellite systems, and life-cycle mitigation.
